His female counterpart is {{ga|Dawn}}. ==In the core series games== ===As the protagonist=== ====Pokémon Diamond, Pearl, Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl==== Lucas lives in [[Twinleaf Town]] with his mother. Lucas and {{ga|Barry}} both see a television program about a [[red Gyarados]], so the two head to the nearby [[Lake Verity]] in search of a similar Pokémon. As the enter the lake area, Professor Rowan and his assistant {{ga|Dawn}} are leaving, but have inadvertently left a briefcase behind. Lucas and Barry wander into the tall grass, but are suddenly attacked by wild {{p|Starly}}; as a last resort, they each use one of the Pokémon in the briefcase the Professor has forgotten. The two take their Pokémon to Sandgem Town to return them to Professor Rowan, but Rowan decides to let the two keep their Pokémon, and also gives them each a [[Pokédex]]. Lucas goes on to gather the eight [[Gym Badge]]s of [[Sinnoh]], defeat [[Team Galactic]], and conquer the {{si|Pokémon League}}. He has to stop [[Team Galactic]] from trying to use either {{p|Dialga}}{{sup/4|D}}{{sup/8|BD}} or {{p|Palkia}}{{sup/4|P}}{{sup/8|SP}} to destroy the entire universe in order to create a new one. ====Pokémon Platinum==== Lucas lives in [[Twinleaf Town]] with his mother. Lucas and {{ga|Barry}} both see a television program about Professor Rowan, so the two head to [[Sandgem Town]] to visit Professor Rowan at his lab to get some Pokémon of their own. They receive their Pokémon on {{rt|201|Sinnoh}} when Professor Rowan realizes that they are so dedicated to Pokémon that they would attempt to travel from Twinleaf Town to [[Sandgem Town]] through the [[tall grass]] without any Pokémon of their own. Lucas goes on to gather the eight [[Gym Badge]]s of [[Sinnoh]], defeat [[Team Galactic]], and conquer the {{si|Pokémon League}}. He has to go to the [[Distortion World]] and face Giratina, in order to stop both worlds from destroying each other. ====Pokémon Black, White, Black 2, and White 2==== In Pokémon Black, White, Black 2, and White 2, the player character from Diamond, Pearl and Platinum and their exploits are referenced by [[Cynthia]], who remembers a young Trainer who had defeated her. ===As a non-playable character=== If the player chooses Dawn, Lucas appears in the game as an NPC. He serves as [[Professor Rowan]]'s assistant. He lives in [[Sandgem Town]] with his little sister, grandfather, and father—who also works as an assistant of Professor Rowan. He received his [[first partner Pokémon]] before the player, having either a {{p|Turtwig}}, {{p|Chimchar}} or {{p|Piplup}}—the Pokémon he has is always the one that has a type disadvantage against the player's first partner Pokémon. Together with his friend {{adv|Pearl}}, they form an aspiring {{wp|manzai}} comedy duo. He is a big glutton with a love for the [[Proteam Omega]] TV show. ====Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!==== {{main|Hareta}} Hareta from [[Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!]] is based on Lucas. He's a dimwitted, headstrong boy who was partially raised in the wild after [[Kaisei|his father]] left him in [[Professor Rowan]]'s care as a small child, causing him to constantly misunderstand how some everyday things, like [[Poké Ball]]s or [[Bicycle|bikes]], are supposed to be used. ====Pocket Monsters DP==== {{main|Dia (Pocket Monsters DP)}} Dia from {{OBP|Pocket Monsters DP|Kosaku Anakubo}} is based on Lucas's design. ====Pokémon Diamond and Pearl==== {{main|Kenta (PDPV)}} Kenta from {{ma|Pokémon Diamond and Pearl}} is based on Lucas. ====Pocket Monsters Diamond and Pearl: Regigigas Major Capture Operation!!==== {{main|Kaito (RMCO)}} Kaito from [[Pocket Monsters Diamond and Pearl: Regigigas Major Capture Operation!!]] is based on Lucas. ==In the TCG== This listing is of cards mentioning or featuring Lucas or his Pokémon in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. {{cardlist/header|Other related cards|Supporter|char=yes}} {{cardlist/entry|cardname={{TCG ID|Crown Zenith|Friends in Sinnoh|131}}|type=Supporter|standard=yes|enset=Crown Zenith|enrarity=Uncommon|ennum=131/159|jpset=VSTAR Universe|jpnum=154/172|enset2=Crown Zenith|enrarity2=Rare Ultra|ennum2=149/159|jpset2=VSTAR Universe|jprarity2=SR|jpnum2=247/172}} {{cardlist/footer|Supporter}} ==Trivia== [[File:Lucas anime artwork.png|thumb|220px|Animation concept art]] * In the early development of {{game|Diamond and Pearl|s}}, Lucas was originally going to have a father, which is further evidenced by script files leftover in their remakes, [[Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl]].https://web.archive.org/web/20231001124935/https://twitter.com/Lewchube/status/1708462187696595066 * The majority of his Japanese default names are shared with {{ga|Red}} from {{game|FireRed and LeafGreen|s}} and {{ga|Ethan}} from {{game|HeartGold and SoulSilver|s}}. * Lucas is 4'8" (142 cm) tall and weighs 83.8 lbs (38 kg).
